_meta.description: International AI transparency and governance public-record tracker. Entries summarize official treaty, regional law, and intergovernmental framework sources only.
_meta.scopeNote: Planning and reference aid only. This is not a legal-compliance map. The dataset separates binding instruments from non-binding principles, voluntary codes, and policy frameworks.

records.title: Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence and Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law
records.citation: Council of Europe Treaty Series No. 225
records.summary: First international legally binding treaty in the AI field, opened for signature on 5 September 2024 and focused on ensuring AI lifecycle activities are consistent with human rights, democracy, and the rule of law.

records.title: Artificial Intelligence Act
records.summary: European Union regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence. It is regional law rather than a global treaty.

records.title: OECD Recommendation of the Council on Artificial Intelligence
records.summary: Intergovernmental AI principles adopted in 2019 and updated in 2024, with values-based principles and policy recommendations for trustworthy AI.

records.title: Seizing the opportunities of safe, secure and trustworthy artificial intelligence systems for sustainable development
records.summary: UN General Assembly resolution on safe, secure, and trustworthy AI systems for sustainable development, including international cooperation and human-rights considerations.

records.title: Hiroshima AI Process Comprehensive Policy Framework
records.citation: G7 Leaders' Statement on the Hiroshima AI Process, 30 October 2023
records.summary: G7 framework built around priority-risk analysis, international guiding principles, a voluntary code of conduct for advanced AI developers, and project-based cooperation.
